newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar firms, below resistance.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar firms, below resistance.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were higher in thin and rangebound trade as producer scale-up selling limited gains to just below resistance, dealers said.
At 1130 EDT, most-active July was 0.02 cent firmer at 10.82 cents per lb, having ranged from 10.86 to 10.79 cents. The rest of the board stood unchanged to 0.03 cent higher.
Volume was estimated at 3,763 lots as of 1100 EST.

Floor sources cited light refiner buying underneath the market, and pro,ducer scale-up selling. The selling overhead held July below resistance pegged at a gap on the charts between 10.86 and 10.92 cents.

A move over resistance could lift the most-active month towards its next overhead target of 11.00 cents, analysts said, but they expect prices to ease back towards 10.50 cents amid a heavy speculative long position in July, and scant physical offtake.
Open interest in July stood at 75,644 lots, down 6,768 lots, as of early Friday.
Traders said a public holiday in London that kept LIFFE closed, contributed to the dull tone in New York.
